steps.title: From full fridge to full plate in three steps
steps.s1d: Add ingredients with one click, or snap a photo of your fridge for instant AI detection.
steps.s2d: The smart matching engine ranks every recipe by how much of it is already in your kitchen.
steps.s3d: Follow step-by-step guides with dynamic portion scaling — or let the AI chef invent something new.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Yes. You can run it fully free with your own Google AI Studio key, or completely offline against a local LM Studio server.
faq.q2: How accurate is the fridge scanner?
faq.a2: The vision model detects common produce, dairy, meats and packaged goods with confidence scores shown per item. You always confirm detections before they enter your pantry.
faq.a3: We rank dishes by what you already have: 100% matches need no shopping at all, and partial matches list exactly which items are missing.
faq.a4: No. Hit Try Instant Demo and get a pre-stocked demo pantry immediately — no email, no credit card.
faq.a5: The app installs as a PWA and your pantry stays viewable offline. Generative features stream from Gemini or local LM Studio when back online.
